messages:
Alex: Planning to push the 'pebble-wave' canary today at 10:30 PST (rolling to 1% -> 5% over 30m). Need a deploy owner + smoke owners and rollback guard. Target cohorts: 1% west-us, 0.5% eu-west to start. @Maria @Julian can you take deploy/ops?
Maria: I can own the deploy window. I'll be on call 10:15-11:15. Will coordinate with infra if we need to scale pools. :+1:
Julian: I can do smoke and quick perf checks. What's the smoke checklist?
Alex: thanks. Smoke checklist (quick):
```
1) infra health: curl -sSf https://infra-api.redwood-inference.internal/health
2) runtime smoke: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":8}'
3) latency sample: run `python tools/latency_sample.py --cohort pebble-wave --n 50`
4) KV cache sanity: check 'kv-cache-miss-rate < 0.5%' in console for 10m
```
Sophie: I'll monitor console dashboards and alerts during ramp. I'm near the dashboard at 10:20.
Leo: I'll prepare rollback playbook in the thread: short checklist is
- pin traffic back to previous model variant
- scale down canary pool to 0
- evacuate sessions (kv cache flush)
- notify clients via webhook status
I'll paste exact commands before 10:25.
Julian: Quick question — do we need to set a gradual token-limit flag for this canary? Some queries in west-us can be long.
Alex: good catch. Set `max_seq_len=1024` override on the cohort config for safety. Maria, can you include that in the deploy manifest?
Maria: yep will add `overrides: { \"max_seq_len\": 1024 }` to canary-config and push to staging now.
Alex: Also keeping autoscale headroom at +20% during first 15m.
Sophie: alert thresholds to watch: 95p latency > 350ms, error rate > 0.5%, token cost spike > 2x baseline.
Maria: staging deploy succeeded. tagging deploy owner: @Maria. Ready to promote to canary at 10:30.
Julian: smoke run results from staging: health ok, generate latency median 120ms, no errors in 100 samples.
Leo: rollback commands (quick):
```bash
# pin traffic back
redwoodctl routes update --route pebble-wave --model previous-variant --percent 100
# scale canary down
redwoodctl pools scale --pool pebble-wave-canary --replicas 0
# flush kv cache
redwoodctl runtime kv-flush --pool pebble-wave-canary
```
Alex: ok team — proceeding with canary start at 10:30. Will post progress at 10:35 and 10:50. If any red flags, call rollback immediately.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Maria for 10:30 PST. Canary cohort: pebble-wave-1 (1% west-us, 0.5% eu-west). CI checks: passed.
Alex: thanks everyone. :rocket:
Sophie: I'll post a short summary at 10:50 with system metrics and notes.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 1748457000. Progress: 1% -> 3% after 10m, 5% at 30m.
